གྱིས་ཤིག: do! (gyis, imperative of byed 'do', + shig, which marks a command)
འཇོག་པར: to rest, to place ('jog 'place, rest' + -par, 'to'); thog tu 'jog par zhu 'I beg you to rest upon'
ཞུའོ: is to be requested, request (zhu + the sentence-ending -'o)
ཉོན་ཅིག: listen! (nyon, imperative of nyan 'listen', + cig, which marks a command)
ཨང: ang: the letters are clear, the sense is not; taken, as a guess, for a spoken cry that presses a command home
ད་ལྟའི: of the present, of now (da lta 'now' + -'i 'of')
ཤེས་རིག: knowing-awareness, present awareness (shes 'know' + rig 'awareness'; shes pa and rig pa together)
ངོ་བོ: essence, nature, what a thing is in itself (ngo bo)
སིང་ངེ་བ: vivid, bright (sing nge ba, a descriptive word with a doubled sound)
ངོ་བོར: as an essence, as a nature (ngo bo + -r 'as')

འདི་ཀ: this very, this same ('di 'this' + ka, intensifier)

ཝལ་ལེ་བ: distinct, sharp, crisp (wal le ba, a descriptive word)
ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་པོ: the All-Good, Samantabhadra, the male buddha who stands for clear awareness (kun tu 'in every way' + bzang 'good' + -po, masculine) · also the bodhisattva of that name (Samantabhadra), one of the eight great bodhisattvas

ཆེན་པོར: as a great one, great (chen po 'great' + -r 'as')

བརྗོད་དོ: says, is to be said (brjod, past and future of rjod 'to say', + the sentence-ending -do)
རང་རིག: self-knowing, awareness aware of itself (rang 'self' + rig 'know')

ཅིག: one, a (gcig written without its prefix g-)
ཟེར: say, call (zer 'say, speak') · ray, ray of light (zer), as in 'od zer, and sgra 'od zer gsum 'sound, light and rays'
ཡོད་མེད: whether there is or not (yod 'there is' + med 'there is not')
བསྟུན་ནོ: is in keeping with, depends on (bstun 'conform' + the sentence-ending -no)

གདབ: to be given, to cast (gdab, future of 'debs 'to cast, to give')

མངོན་རྟོགས: clear realisation, the text describing a deity to be visualised (mngon 'clear' + rtogs 'realise')
ཀློགས: read out (klogs, imperative of klog 'to read')

ཇོ་བོ: lord, master (jo bo); title of Avalokiteśvara

མུན་བ: darkness (mun pa, spelled mun ba in this print)

གྲོལ་ལོ: is freed, was freed (grol 'be freed' + the sentence-ending -lo)
ཤར་དུ: to arise, to dawn (shar, past of 'char 'arise', + -du 'to'): shar du 'ong 'will arise'

ཐོས: heard, hears (thos 'to hear', the verb of hearing, beside nyan 'to listen')

བྱུང: came about, happened, occurred (byung, past of 'byung)
བརྗེད་པར: forgetting, to forget (brjed 'forget' + -par 'to'); ma brjed par 'without forgetting'
ཚིག་དོན: the words and their meaning (tshig 'word' + don 'meaning')
སོང་ཞིག: go! (song, imperative of 'gro 'go', + zhig, which marks a command)

ལྷང་ལྷང: clearly, distinctly (lhang lhang, a doubled word)
སྣང་པ: appearance (snang pa, the print's spelling of snang ba)
བརྗེད་ཅིག: forget! (brjed 'forget' + cig, which marks a command); ma brjed cig 'do not forget'
བྲལ་བའི: of parting, of being free of (bral 'part, be free of' + -ba'i 'of')

ཉམས་ང་བ: fearsome, awesome (nyams nga ba, the print's spelling of nyam nga ba)
སོས་ཁའི: of spring (sos kha, the print's spelling of sos ka, + -'i 'of')

འཆར་དུ: to dawn, to arise ('char 'dawn, arise' + -du 'to'): 'char du 'ong 'will dawn'

རང་མདངས: own radiance, natural glow (rang 'self' + mdangs 'radiance, glow')
ནང: inside, within (nang): 'od kyi nang nas 'from within the light'

དི་རི་རི: a rumbling sound (di ri ri, a doubled-sound word)
བག་ཆགས: habitual tendencies, the traces past actions leave in the mind (bag chags; Sanskrit vāsanā)
རྡོས་བྱས: made of coarse matter, solid (rdos byas, the print's spelling of gdos bcas 'material')
མེད་པས: because there is not (med 'there is not' + -pas 'because')
འཆི་རྒྱུ: something to die, an occasion for dying ('chi 'die' + rgyu 'cause, occasion')
གྱིས་ཅིག: do! (gyis, imperative of byed 'do', + cig, which marks a command; the print's cig for shig)
མི་ཡུལ་དུ: in the human world, in the land of humans (mi 'person' + yul 'land' + -du 'in')
བསྒོམ་སྒྲུབ: meditation and practice (bsgom, future of sgom 'to meditate', + sgrub 'to practise, to accomplish')
གདམས་བའི: of instruction (gdams 'instruct' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
འཁྱམ་མོ: wanders ('khyam, a form of 'khyams 'wander', + the sentence-ending -mo)
བཞིའི: of four (bzhi 'four' + -'i 'of'); zhag phyed dang bzhi 'three and a half days'
བསངས་པ: cleared, having cleared (bsangs 'cleared' + -pa): brgyal bsangs pa 'the faint having cleared'

སྙམ་བའི: of thinking (snyam 'think' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
འཁོར་བའི: of saṃsāra, of the round ('khor ba 'the round, saṃsāra' + -'i 'of')

མཐིང་ཁར: as deep blue (mthing kha, the print's spelling of mthing ga, + -r 'as')

སྐུ་མདོག: body colour, colour of a buddha or deity (sku 'body' + mdog 'colour'), the respectful word
འཁོར་ལོ: wheel ('khor lo); the wheel of the teaching

མོས་བ: devotion (mos ba, the print's spelling of mos pa)

སྐྱོལ: bring! deliver! (skyol, imperative of skyel 'to bring, to convey')
དེ་སྐད་དུ: thus, in these words (de 'that' + skad 'speech, words' + -du 'in')

འཇའ་འོད་དུ: as rainbow light, into rainbow light ('ja' 'rainbow' + 'od 'light' + -du 'as, into')

འགྱུར་རོ: becomes, will become ('gyur 'to become, to change' + the sentence-ending -ro)
ཞེ་སྡང: anger, hatred (zhe sdang), the mind's poison of the second day
སྡིག་སྒྲིབ: sinful obscuration, the veil that harmful deeds leave on the mind (sdig 'sin' + sgrib 'obscuration')
རྐྱེན: condition, circumstance, cause (rkyen): rkyen gyis 'through the force of'

བསྐོར: surrounded, encircled (bskor, past of skor 'to surround, to circle')
ཀླུང: expanse: the print's spelling of klong (klung as a word by itself is 'river')
གཟུགས: form, the body and all that can be seen (gzugs): the first of the five aggregates
ལྟ་བུའི: like, of the kind of (lta bu 'like' + -'i): me long lta bu'i 'like a mirror'

བལྟ་བར: in looking, looking (blta, future stem of lta 'look', + -bar): mig ma blta bar 'without looking with the eye'
སྤོངས་ཤིག: give up! (spongs, imperative of spong 'give up', + shig, which marks a command)
སངས་རྒྱས་སྤྱན་མས: by Buddha-Eye, by Buddhalocanā (sangs rgyas spyan ma + -s 'by')
བསྐྱོར: held up, to hold up, support (bskyor, past and future stem of skyor 'hold up'); in a request, perhaps standing for 'hold up!'
མངོན་བར་དགའ་བའི: of Manifest Joy (mngon bar, the print's spelling of mngon par 'manifestly', + dga' ba 'joy' + -'i 'of')
ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུར: as the body of perfect enjoyment (longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku + -r 'as')

རིན་པོ་ཆེ: precious, a precious thing, jewel (rin 'value' + po + che 'great')
མཱ་མ་ཀི: Māmakī, 'She Who Is Mine': a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters, the consort of the south
ནམ་མཁའི་སྙིང་པོ: Essence of Space (nam mkha' 'sky, space' + -'i + snying po 'essence'; Sanskrit Ākāśagarbha): a bodhisattva
མཱ་ལྱམ: Mālyā, 'she of the garland' (mā lyam, the print's letters for a Sanskrit name from mālya 'garland'; the other recension has mā le ma): a female bodhisattva
དྷུ་པེ་མ: Dhūpā, 'she of incense' (dhu pe, for Sanskrit dhūpe, the name in the form used in addressing her, from dhūpa 'incense', + -ma, feminine): a female bodhisattva
ཚོར་བའི: of feeling (tshor ba 'feeling' + -'i 'of'): feeling is the second of the five aggregates
དག་བ: pure, being pure (dag ba, the print's spelling of dag pa)
ཐིག་ལེ: drop, sphere, point of light (thig le)
བརྒྱན་པ: adorned, decorated (brgyan, past of rgyan 'to adorn', + -pa)
བལྟ: to look (blta, future stem of lta 'look'): blta mi bzod pa 'unbearable to look at'
ཐད་ཀར: straight at, level with (thad ka 'straight toward' + -r): snying gi thad kar 'at the level of the heart'
གཤིབ་མར: side by side (the print's other spelling of gshibs mar)
སྙིང་ཁར: at the heart, into the heart (snying kha 'heart' + -r 'at, into')
བྲོས་སུ: fleeing, in flight (bros, past of 'bros 'to flee', + -su): bros su 'ong 'will flee'
ཆགས་སེམས: a mind of attachment, desire (chags 'be attached' + sems 'mind')
བྱར་མེད: with nothing to do, effortless (bya, future stem of byed 'do', 'to be done', + -r + med 'there is not')
བཞོགས་ཤིག: rest! leave it! (bzhogs + shig, which marks a command; perhaps the print's form for zhog, imperative of 'jog 'place, leave')
དབྱེར་མེད་དུ: inseparably, without being apart (dbyer med 'without separation' + -du)
འོང་བ: coming (the present stem 'ong 'come' + -ba): 'ong ba yin no 'is coming'
ཡིན་བའི: which is, of being (yin 'be' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
ལྟུང: to fall (ltung, the present and future stem of the verb whose past is lhung)
སྐྱེ: birth, to be born (skye, the present and future stem; past skyes); skye rga na 'chi 'birth, ageing, sickness and death'
རྒ: old age, ageing; to grow old (rga)
ཉམས་སུ་མྱོང: to experience, to go through (nyams su myong; nyams 'experience' + -su + myong 'taste, undergo')
ཞིང: and, while: links one verb to the next (zhing, the form used after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; also cing, shing) · realm, field; a buddha-field (zhing, short for zhing khams): dag pa'i zhing 'pure realm'
ཐོན་པའི: of emerging, of getting out (thon 'get out, emerge' + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
བཀག་པའི: of what has blocked, that blocks (bkag, past stem of 'gog 'to block', + -pa'i 'of'): a clause placed before its noun
རྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: one-pointedly, with a single mind (rtse 'point, tip' + gcig 'one' + -tu)
མཉམ་ཉིད: sameness, equality (mnyam 'equal' + nyid 'itself'): mnyam nyid ye shes 'the wisdom of sameness', shortened from mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes
ཡི: of (the form used after a vowel, yi; also gi, kyi, gyi, -'i) · perhaps 'by', standing for yis, where the verse needs it
ལ་སོགས་པ: and the like, and so on (la 'to' + sogs 'et cetera' + -pa)
ཉམས་པ: broken, impaired, spoiled (nyams 'decline, be damaged' + -pa): dam tshig nyams pa 'a broken commitment'
ལ་སོགས་པའི: of those and the like, and so on (la sogs pa + -'i 'of')
སྐལ་ཆད: cut off from fortune, luckless (skal 'fortune, lot' + chad 'cut off', past of 'chad)
འདོད་ཆགས: desire, passion ('dod 'want' + chags 'attachment'): the mind's poison of the fourth day
བསྐྱོད: stirred, set in motion (bskyod, past and future stem of skyod 'to move, to stir')
བྲོས་བས: because (they) fled, fleeing (bros, past of 'bros 'to flee', + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'because'): runs on to what follows
བཞི་པ: fourth (bzhi 'four' + -pa): zhag bzhi pa 'the fourth day'
ཡི་དྭགས: hungry ghost (yi dwags; Sanskrit preta), a being tormented by hunger and thirst
བོད: will call, to call (bod, the future stem of 'bod 'to call')
བདེ་བ་ཅན: the Blissful, Sukhāvatī, the buddha-field of the west (bde ba 'bliss' + can 'having')
གོས་དཀར་མོ: the White-Robed One, Pāṇḍaravāsinī (gos 'clothing' + dkar 'white' + -mo, the feminine ending): the consort of the west
སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས: Avalokiteśvara, 'the one who looks with the eyes' (spyan 'eye', respectful, + ras + gzigs 'look', respectful): the bodhisattva of compassion
འཇམ་དཔལ: Mañjuśrī, 'Gentle Glory' ('jam 'gentle' + dpal 'glory'): the bodhisattva of wisdom
གྷཱིརྟི་མ: perhaps Gītā, 'she of song' (ghīrti, the print's letters, perhaps for gīti 'song', + -ma): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters
ཨཱ་ལོ་ཀེ: Ālokā, 'she of light' (ā lo ke, Sanskrit āloke, the form of address of the name Ālokā, from āloka 'light'): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters
སོ་སོར: one by one, each by itself (so so 'each' + -r): so sor rtogs pa 'discerning each thing by itself'
རྟོགས་བའི: of understanding, of discerning (rtogs 'understand' + -ba'i, the print's spelling of -pa'i 'of')
ཆགས་ཞེན: attachment and clinging (chags 'be attached' + zhen 'cling'), the two verbs made one word
དྲག་པོའི: of the fierce, of the strong (drag po 'fierce' + -'i 'of')
ངང་དུ: in the state, in the condition (ngang 'state, nature' + -du 'in')
བྲོས་ཅིག: flee! (bros, the imperative of 'bros 'to flee', + cig, which marks a command; the rule gives shig after s, the print writes cig); ma bros cig 'do not flee'
ཆགས་པར: in being attached, attached (chags pa + -r): chags par byed 'be attached'
གླགས: opportunity, chance (glags): bzod glags med pa 'with no chance to bear it', unbearable
མྱོང: to experience, to suffer, to undergo (myong)
ཐར་ལམ: path to liberation (thar 'liberation' + lam 'path'), shortened from thar pa'i lam
སོར་རྟོགས: the discerning (wisdom) (sor rtogs, shortened from so sor rtogs pa 'discerning each thing by itself')
བསྐྱོལ: bring! (bskyol, read as skyol, the imperative of skyel 'bring', written with a prefixed b-)
སྲིད་དོ: can be, is possible (srid 'be possible' + the sentence-ending -do): mi srid 'it cannot be, it is impossible'
ཡུན་རིང་པའི: of long duration, long-lasting (yun 'duration' + ring pa 'long' + -'i 'of')
སྟབས: occasion, manner, circumstance (stabs): stabs kyis 'because of, by reason of'
སྤོང་བར: giving up (spong 'give up' + -bar): mi spong bar 'without giving up'
ཕྲག་དོག: jealousy, envy (phrag dog): the mind's poison of the fifth day
དངངས་སྐྲག: dread and terror (dngangs, the print's spelling of sngangs 'dread', + skrag 'be frightened')
མར: down, downward (mar, the opposite of yar 'up'); of time, 'on, onward' · butter (mar), another word of the same spelling
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པའི: of Amoghasiddhi (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished' + -'i 'of')
བྱོན་ནོ: comes, came (byon, the respectful 'come, go', used of a buddha or other honoured being, with one form for every tense, + the sentence-ending -no)
ཉོན་མོངས་པ: affliction, disturbing emotion (nyon mongs pa; Sanskrit kleśa), the name for the poisons of the mind
ལྷ་མ་ཡིན: demigod, asura (lha ma yin 'not-god'): a being who wars with the gods out of envy
ལྔ་པ: fifth (lnga 'five' + -pa): zhag lnga pa 'the fifth day'
རབ་བརྩེགས་པའི: of Heaped Up, of the piled high (rab 'very' + brtsegs 'piled up', past of rtseg + -pa'i 'of'): the name of a buddha-field of the north
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་པ: Amoghasiddhi, 'He Whose Aim Is Accomplished' (don yod 'not in vain' + grub pa 'accomplished'): the buddha of the north and of the fifth day
གཙོ་འཁོར: chief and retinue (gtso 'chief' + 'khor 'retinue'): the buddha with those around him
རྡོ་རྗེ་རྒྱ་གྲམ: crossed vajra (Sanskrit viśvavajra; rdo rje 'vajra' + rgya gram 'cross'): two vajras laid across each other, the emblem of the north
ནམ་མཁའ་ལྡིང: the garuḍa, the great bird (nam mkha' 'sky' + lding 'soar, hover': 'soaring in the sky')
ཤང་ཤང: shang-shang, a winged creature of the garuḍa kind, in pictures part bird and part human
དམ་ཚིག་སྒྲོལ་མ: Samayatārā, 'Tārā of the Commitment' (dam tshig 'sacred commitment' + sgrol ma 'she who frees'): the consort of the north
སེམས་དཔའ: hero, bodhisattva (sems 'mind' + dpa' 'hero'; short for byang chub sems dpa', 'hero of awakening')
ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ: Vajra-in-Hand (phyag na 'in the hand' + rdo rje 'vajra'; Sanskrit Vajrapāṇi): one of the bodhisattvas around Amoghasiddhi, in the north
སྒྲིབ་པ་རྣམ་བར་སེལ་བ: He Who Completely Clears Away the Obscurations (sgrib pa 'obscuration' + rnam par 'completely' + sel ba 'clearing away'; Sanskrit Sarvanivaraṇaviṣkambhin): a bodhisattva of the north (the print writes rnam bar, its usual b for p)
གྷནྡྷེ་མ: Gandhā, 'she of perfume' (gandhe, the Sanskrit name in the form used in addressing her, from gandha 'scent', + -ma, feminine): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters
ནཱིར་ཏི་མ: perhaps Nṛtyā, 'she of dance' (nīr ti, the print's letters, which do not plainly spell the name, + -ma, feminine): a female bodhisattva, a Sanskrit name in Tibetan letters
འདུ་བྱེད: formation, putting together ('du 'gather' + byed 'make'; Sanskrit saṃskāra): the fourth of the five aggregates, the impulses and habits by which the mind shapes what it does
ལྗང: green (ljang): ljang khu 'green'; ljang la 'green and'
སྤྲས་པ: adorned, decked (spras, past of spra 'to adorn', + -pa)
རང་རྩལ: own energy, natural play (rang 'self' + rtsal 'skill, power'): what awareness shows of itself
ཉེ་རིང: near and far (nye 'near' + ring 'far'): taking some things as one's own and others as strange
བཏང་སྙོམས: equanimity (btang 'let go', past of gtong, + snyoms 'made even')
ཆེན་པོའི: of the great (chen po 'great' + -'i 'of'): byar med chen po'i ngang du 'in the state of great non-doing'
རྒྱུ: cause (rgyu) · after a verb, what is to be, what is to happen: sangs rgyas rgyu yin pa 'it was to be that you became a buddha'
བསྒོམས་ཤིག: meditate! (bsgoms, the past stem of sgom 'meditate', here as a command, as sgoms is elsewhere, + shig, which marks a command)
དམན་པ: low, weak, inferior (dman pa): blo dman pa 'of weak mind'
ནའང: even if (na 'if' + 'ang 'even'): yin na'ang 'even if it is'
བཞོག་ཅིག: rest! leave it! (bzhog, kept as printed and read as zhog, imperative of 'jog 'to put, to leave', or a spelling of it, + cig, which marks a command)
ལྕགས་ཀྱུའི: of the iron hook (lcags kyu 'iron hook' + -'i 'of')
བྲོས་ཤིག: flee! (bros, imperative of 'bros 'to flee', + shig, which marks a command); ma bros shig 'do not flee'
འབྲལ་མེད་དུ: inseparably, without parting ('bral 'part, be separated' + med 'without' + -du)
འཐབ་རྩོད: fighting and quarrel ('thab 'fight' + rtsod 'quarrel, dispute'): the life of the demigods
དྲག་བོས: by the fierce (drag bos, the print's spelling, perhaps for drag pos: drag po 'fierce' + -s 'by')
བྱ་གྲུབ: deeds accomplished (bya ba 'deed' + grub pa 'accomplished', shortened for the metre): bya grub ye shes 'the wisdom that accomplishes deeds'
དོན་ཡོད་གྲུབ་བས: by Amoghasiddhi (don yod 'meaningful' + grub 'accomplished' + -bas, the print's spelling of -pas 'by'): the buddha of the north
དམ་ཚིག་སྒྲོལ་མས: by Commitment-Saviouress (dam tshig 'commitment, vow' + sgrol ma 'saviouress', i.e. Tārā, + -s 'by'): the consort of Amoghasiddhi
ལས་འཕྲོ: karmic residue (las 'karma' + 'phro 'remainder'): what is left over of past deeds and goes on working; in this text the good karma from past lives that ties a person to the teaching
ཚན་ཆེ: strong, of great force (tshan che; read so) · great in number, prevailing
དག་སྣང: pure vision (dag 'pure' + snang 'appearance'): the world seen as the deities and their realms
འདྲིས: familiar, familiarity ('dris): sngar 'dris med pa 'without earlier familiarity'
ཕྱི: outside, outer, behind, back (phyi): phyi la khrid 'led back'
འཁོར: to circle, to go round ('khor; the verb of 'khor ba, saṃsāra) · retinue, the company around a deity ('khor): 'khor dang bcas pa 'together with the retinue'
རིགས་ལྔ: the five families (rigs 'family' + lnga 'five'): the five buddhas, each with his consort and the deities of his family
བཅས་པ: together with, accompanied by (bcas pa): 'khor dang bcas pa 'together with the retinue'
རིགས་དྲུག: the six kinds (rigs 'kind' + drug 'six'): the six classes of beings, the realms of rebirth
སོ་སོའི: of each, each one's (so so 'each, separate' + -'i 'of')
སྐྲག་དངངས: fright and terror (skrag 'be frightened' + dngangs 'dread'): the same two words as dngangs skrag, in the other order
སྐྱེས་པས: because it arose, having arisen (skyes pa 'arisen' + -s 'because')
ཕན་ཆད་དུ: up to, until, from then on (phan chad 'up to, onward' + -du): da phan chad du 'until now'
ཤེས་པས: because of knowing (shes pa 'knowing' + -s 'because'): ma shes pas 'because you did not know'
སྦྱོར: to join, to unite (sbyor, the present stem; past and future sbyar): ye shes bzhi sbyor 'the four wisdoms joined'
པདྨ་བརྩེགས་པ: Lotus-Heaped (padma 'lotus' + brtsegs pa 'heaped up, stacked', past of rtseg): a second name, or a description, of the western buddha-field, which the text does not make clear
ཕྱི་རིམ་དུ: in the outer tier, on the outer ring (phyi 'outer' + rim 'tier, ring' + -du 'in')
སྒོ་བ: gatekeeper (sgo 'gate' + -ba, here 'the one of the gate')
རྣམ་པར་རྒྱལ་བ: Fully Victorious (rnam par 'completely' + rgyal ba 'victorious'; Sanskrit Vijaya): one of the four wrathful male gatekeepers, named first in this text
གཤིན་རྗེ་གཤེད་པོ: Slayer of the Lord of Death (gshin rje 'lord of the dead' + gshed po 'slayer'; Sanskrit Yamāntaka): a wrathful male gatekeeper
རྟ་མགྲིན་རྒྱལ་པོ: Horse-Neck, the king (rta 'horse' + mgrin 'neck' + rgyal po 'king'; Sanskrit Hayagrīva): a wrathful male gatekeeper
བདུད་རྩི་འཁྱིལ་པ: Coil of Nectar (bdud rtsi 'nectar' + 'khyil pa 'coiled, swirling'; Sanskrit Amṛtakuṇḍalin): a wrathful male gatekeeper
ལྕགས་ཀྱུ་མ: Iron-Hook Lady (lcags kyu 'iron hook' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the hook she holds
ཞགས་པ་མ: Noose Lady (zhags pa 'noose' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the noose she holds
ལྕགས་སྒྲོག་མ: Iron-Chain Lady (lcags 'iron' + sgrog 'chain' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the chain she holds
དྲིལ་བུ་མ: Bell Lady (dril bu 'bell' + -ma, feminine): a female gatekeeper, named for the bell she holds
ཐུབ་པ: able, capable (thub 'to be able' + -pa) · the sage, the Able One (Sanskrit muni): a buddha who appears in each of the six realms of rebirth to teach its beings
དབང་པོ་བརྒྱ་བྱིན: Lord of a Hundred Offerings (dbang po 'lord' + brgya 'hundred' + byin 'given', past of sbyin 'give'; Sanskrit Śatakratu, 'of a hundred sacrifices'): Indra, king of the gods, here the sage of the gods
ཐག་བཟང་རིས: Good-Weave-Pattern (thag 'weave, rope' + bzang 'good' + ris 'pattern'): the king of the demigods, Sanskrit Vemacitra; here the sage of the demigods
ཤཱཀྱ་སེངྒེ: Lion of the Śākyas (Śākya, the clan of the Buddha, + seng ge 'lion'; Sanskrit Śākyasiṃha): the Buddha of our age, the sage of humans
བྱོལ་སོང: animal (byol song): one of the six kinds of beings
སེངྒེ་རབ་བརྟན: Very Steadfast Lion (seng ge 'lion' + rab 'very' + brtan 'steadfast'): the sage of the animals
ཁ་འབར་མ: Blazing Mouth (kha 'mouth' + 'bar 'blaze' + -ma, which usually marks a woman): the sage of the hungry ghosts
ཆོས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ: King of the Teaching, dharma king (chos 'teaching' + kyi 'of' + rgyal po 'king'; Sanskrit dharmarāja): the sage of the hell beings
སྤྱི་མེས: common forefather (spyi 'general, of all' + mes 'grandfather, ancestor')
ཀུན་བཟང: All-Good (kun 'all' + bzang 'good'): the short form of Kun tu bzang po, Samantabhadra
ལོངས་སྐུའི: of the body of enjoyment (longs sku, short for longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku, + -'i 'of')
བཞི་བཅུ་རྩ་གཉིས: forty-two (bzhi bcu 'forty' + rtsa, which joins the units to the tens, + gnyis 'two')
ཀྱེ: O! (kye, a word of calling; the print's other spelling of kyai)
ཞིག: a, some, one (zhig, the form of cig, gcig 'one', after a vowel and after ng, n, m, r, l, '; shig after s): gzhan zhig 'some other, another'
ཕྱོགས: direction, quarter, side (phyogs): phyogs bzhi 'the four quarters'
ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པ: present of itself, spontaneously accomplished (lhun gyis 'of itself' + grub pa 'accomplished'): a fixed term for what is there without being made
ལས་རབ་རྫོགས་པའི: of Fully Accomplished Action (las 'action, deeds' + rab 'very' + rdzogs 'complete' + -pa'i 'of'): read as the name of the buddha-field of the north (las may also be taken as 'from' before rab rdzogs pa'i, as it was before rab brtsegs pa'i)
ཆ་མཉམ་པ: even in proportion, evenly proportioned (cha 'part, proportion' + mnyam pa 'equal')
རྒྱན: ornament, adornment; to adorn (rgyan, the present stem; past brgyan)
བཞུགས་ཚུལ: manner of sitting (bzhugs, the respectful 'sit' + tshul 'manner')
རང་རང: each its own, each one's own (rang 'self', doubled)
ཕྱག་རྒྱ: hand-seal, the gesture of the hands (phyag 'hand' + rgya 'seal'; Sanskrit mudrā)
ལྔ་ལྔའི: of five and five, of the fives (lnga lnga + -'i 'of'): perhaps the five buddhas, each with his consort; the sense is not sure
རེ་རེ: each, one by one (re re, doubled): re re la 'to each one'
ཡབ: father (yab, respectful); the male of a buddha and his consort
ཆ: part, share, proportion (cha): yab kyi cha 'the father's part'
འཛིན་པའི: of holding, that holds ('dzin 'hold' + -pa + -'i 'of'): cha 'dzin pa'i 'holding the part (of)'
དཀྱིལ་འཁོར: maṇḍala, the circle of a deity and his retinue (dkyil 'centre' + 'khor 'surround'; Sanskrit maṇḍala)
རྫོགས་པར: completely, in full (rdzogs pa 'complete' + -r): gcig la rdzogs par 'complete in one'; the reading rdzogs is not sure on the image
ཡིན་བས: because it is (yin 'is' + -bas, the print's b for p of -pas 'because')
སྦ་ཐག: cord of cane (sba 'cane' + thag 'rope, cord'); the likeness is not sure
དྲིལ་བ: wound, twisted, rolled (dril, past of 'dril 'to roll, to wind', + -ba)
ལྟ་བུ: like, of the kind of (lta bu)
ཉམ་ང་བའི: of the fearsome, fearsome (nyam nga ba + -'i 'of'): the usual spelling, where earlier parts printed nyams nga ba
སྣམ་བུ: strip of woollen cloth (snam bu); a band, as of light
འབྲེལ་མར: joined, connected ('brel 'be connected' + mar, as in gshibs mar 'side by side')
ཁ་སྦུབ་པ: turned mouth-down, upside down (kha 'mouth, face' + sbub 'turned over' + -pa)
ཙམ་པ: about the size of, as much as (tsam 'as much as' + -pa)
ལྔ་ལྔས: by fives, five by five (lnga lnga + -s 'by')
ཕོར་པ: bowl, cup (phor pa, the print's spelling of phor ba)
རྟོགས་པའི: of discerning, of realising (rtogs pa 'realise, discern' + -'i 'of'): so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes 'the discerning wisdom'
རྟོག་བའི: of conceiving, of thinking (rtog 'think, build concepts' + -ba, the print's b for p, + -'i 'of'): mi rtog ba'i ngang 'the state of not conceiving'
ཀློད: to relax, to let loose (klod, another spelling of glod 'to loosen'): klod la zhog cig 'relax, and rest!'
རྫོགས་པས: because it is complete (rdzogs 'be complete' + -pa + -s 'because'): ma rdzogs pas 'because it is not complete'
སྣང་ངོ: appears (snang 'appear' + the sentence-ending -ngo): mi snang ngo 'does not appear'
ཁོང་གསེང: inner hollow, the inner passage (khong 'inside' + gseng 'gap, opening'); also written khong seng
ཤར་བའི: of what dawned, that dawned (shar, the past stem of 'char 'dawn', + -ba + -'i 'of')
བུ: child, son (bu): ma dang bu 'mother and child'
འཕྲད་པ: meeting ('phrad 'meet' + -pa): ma dang bu 'phrad pa 'mother and child meeting'
ལྟ་བུའམ: like, or (lta bu 'like' + -'am 'or'): the first of two likenesses
འདྲིས་པའི: of the familiar, one has been familiar with ('dris pa 'be familiar' + -'i 'of'): 'dris pa'i mi 'a person one has been familiar with'
མཐོང་བ: seeing (mthong 'see' + -ba): mthong ba tsam gyis 'by merely seeing'
སྒྲོ་འདོགས: superimposition, doubt (sgro 'feather' + 'dogs 'tie'): what the mind adds to what is there
ཆོད་པ: cut, cut off, severed (chod, the intransitive beside gcod 'to cut', + -pa): sgro 'dogs chod pa 'doubt cut'
འགྱུར་བ: change, changing ('gyur 'change' + -ba): 'gyur ba med par 'without change'
རྒྱུན: continuity, unbroken flow (rgyun): rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin 'an absorption of continuity'
ལྷུན་གྲུབ: spontaneous presence (lhun grub, short for lhun gyis grub pa 'accomplished of itself'): lhun grub chen po'i sku 'the body of great spontaneous presence'
ལྡོག་གོ: turns (ldog 'turn' + the sentence-ending -go): phyir mi ldog go 'does not turn back'
འཁྲུལ་བའི: of delusion, deluded ('khrul 'be deluded' + -ba + -'i 'of'): ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba 'the impure appearances of delusion'
ཞེ: so, thus (zhe, the form zhes takes before na after ng, n, m, r, l, ' and a vowel; ce na after g, d, b, she na after s): gang zhe na 'if one asks which', the way a list is opened
དམྱལ་པའི: of hell (dmyal pa 'hell' + -'i 'of'); the print's spelling of dmyal ba'i
འཛིན་པ: grasping, holding ('dzin 'hold' + -pa): the mind taking hold of what it sees · holding with compassion (thugs rjes 'dzin pa)
བྱེད་པར: doing (byed pa + -r): ma byed par 'without doing'
དམིགས་པ: reference, the object the mind fixes on (dmigs pa): dmigs pa med pa'i ngang 'the state without reference'
བླངས: taken (blangs, the past stem of len 'take'): lus blangs 'taken a body', that is, born
འཁོར་བ: saṃsāra, the round ('khor ba, 'the round of rebirth')
མེད་བས: because there is not (med 'be without' + -bas, the print's b for p of -pas)
འོ་རྒྱལ་ལོ: how wearisome!, a cry of weariness ('o rgyal, as 'o brgyal 'weary, worn out', + the sentence-ending -lo); the print writes rgyal lo as one syllable
འཛིགས: to fear, to be afraid ('dzigs, the print's spelling of 'jigs): 'jigs shing skrag 'terrified and frightened'
ཆགས་སུ: into attachment, to be attached (chags 'be attached' + -su 'to'): chags su 'ong 'come to be attached'
བདེ་བར་གཤེགས་པའི: of the Sugatas, of those gone to bliss (bde bar 'to bliss' + gshegs pa 'gone' + -'i 'of'; Sanskrit sugata): a name of a buddha
བྱོན་པར: having come, come (byon, the past stem of 'byon, the respectful 'come', + -pa + -r): byon par 'dug gis 'have come, and so'
ཞེན་པར: clinging (zhen pa 'cling' + -r): ma zhen par 'without clinging'
རྒྱལ་བ: victor (rgyal ba), a name of a buddha
དབྱིངས: expanse, space of reality (dbyings): dbyings kyi yum chen 'the great mothers of the expanse'
ཡུམ་ཆེན: great mother (yum 'mother' + chen 'great'): dbyings kyi yum chen 'the great mothers of the expanse', the five consorts
བསྒྲལ: to free, freed (bsgral, the past and future stem of sgrol 'free'): bsgral nas 'having freed'
ལྔ་རུ: to five (lnga + -ru 'to'): zhing mchog lnga ru 'to the five supreme realms'
བསྐྱལ་དུ: to bring (bskyal, the past and future stem of skyel 'bring', + -du): bskyal du gsol 'I pray that you bring'
གཉིས་སུ: into two, as two (gnyis 'two' + -su): gnyis su med par 'without being two, non-dually'
སངས་རྒྱའོ: becomes a buddha (sangs rgya, the present stem, + the sentence-ending -'o)
མངལ: womb (mngal): mngal gyi sgo 'the door of the womb'
ཁོང་སེང: inner hollow, the inner passage (khong 'inside' + seng 'gap, opening', also written gseng)
ཞི་བ: peaceful (zhi ba); the peaceful ones, the peaceful deities, as against khro bo, the wrathful
ཤས་ཆེ་བ: the greater part, the majority (shas 'part, share' + che ba 'great')
འབྱུང་ངོ: occurs, arises ('byung 'occur' + the sentence-ending -ngo): mang du 'byung ngo 'occur in great number'
ཐ་མ: lowest, last (tha ma): tha ma'i yang tha ma 'the lowest even of the lowest'
དམ་ཉམས: one whose commitment is broken (dam, short for dam tshig 'commitment, vow', + nyams 'damaged'): the vows of tantric practice
འཕྲོད་པར: recognition coming, being met ('phrod 'meet' + -pa + -r): ngo sprad kyang mi 'phrod par 'though pointed out, without recognition coming'
འཁྱམས་དུ: wandering ('khyams 'wander' + -du, written where the rule gives -su after -s): 'khyams du 'ong 'come wandering'
བདུན་པ: seventh (bdun 'seven' + -pa): zhag bdun pa 'the seventh day'
མཁའ་སྤྱོད: Sky-Faring (mkha' 'sky' + spyod 'move about, enjoy'; Sanskrit khecara): the realm of the beings who move in space
རིག་འཛིན: knowledge-holder (rig pa 'knowledge' + 'dzin 'hold'; Sanskrit vidyādhara): a master of tantric knowledge
འོད་དུ: in light, into light ('od 'light' + -du): 'ja' dang 'od du 'in rainbow and light'
འཐིབ་པའི: of gathering thick, thick ('thib pa 'gather thick', as clouds do, + -'i 'of')
སྨིན་པའི: of ripening, of the ripened (smin pa 'ripen' + -'i 'of'): rnam par smin pa'i 'of full ripening'
བླ་ན་མེད་པ: unsurpassed, with none above (bla na 'above' + med pa 'without'; Sanskrit anuttara)
པདྨ་གར་གྱི་དབང་ཕྱུག: Lord of the Lotus Dance (padma 'lotus' + gar 'dance' + gyi 'of' + dbang phyug 'lord'; Sanskrit Padmanarteśvara); the name can also be taken as 'Lotus, Lord of Dance': the knowledge-holder of the centre
མཁའ་འགྲོ་མ: sky-goer woman, ḍākinī (mkha' 'sky' + 'gro 'go' + -ma, feminine; Sanskrit ḍākinī)
ཐོད་ཁྲག: skull and blood, a skull cup full of blood (thod 'skull' + khrag 'blood')
འཛིན: to hold, to grasp ('dzin, the present stem; past bzung)
བལྟ་སྟངས: manner of looking, gaze (blta, the future stem of lta 'to look', + stangs 'manner'; also written lta stangs)
གནས་པའི: dwelling, of one who dwells (gnas pa 'to dwell, remain' + -'i 'of'): sa la gnas pa'i 'dwelling on the levels'
འཛུམ་པའི: smiling, of a smile ('dzum 'smile' + -pa + -'i 'of'): 'dzum pa'i mdangs 'a smiling radiance'
མཁའ་འགྲོ: sky-goer, ḍākinī (mkha' 'sky' + 'gro 'go'; also written mkha' 'gro ma, with the feminine -ma)
འཁྲིལ: to wind about, to embrace ('khril): 'khril zhing 'embracing, and'
མཛད: to make, to do (mdzad, the respectful word for 'do'): gar mdzad 'make a dance'
དབང་བའི: of having power, having power over (dbang ba 'to have power' + -'i 'of'): tshe la dbang ba'i 'having power over life'
དཔེ་བྱད: the minor marks, the eighty lesser signs of a buddha's body (dpe byad)
ལྡན་བ: having, endowed with (ldan ba, this print's spelling of ldan pa)
ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པའི: of the spontaneously present, of what is present of itself (lhun gyis 'of itself, spontaneously' + grub pa 'be accomplished, be present' + -'i 'of')
ཁྲོ་འཛུམ: wrathful and smiling, a face both at once (khro 'wrath' + 'dzum 'smile')
འཛིན་པས: by holding, holding ('dzin 'hold' + -pa + -s 'by'): thod khrag 'dzin pas 'holding the skull of blood'
རོལ་དུ: at the side of, round about (rol 'side' + -du 'at'): rnams kyi rol du 'round them'; the usual word is phyi rol 'outside', and the sense is taken from the context
མཁའ་འགྲོ་མའི: of sky-goer women, of ḍākinīs (mkha' 'gro ma + -'i 'of')
བཅུའི: of ten (bcu 'ten' + -'i 'of'): gnas bcu'i 'of the ten places'
ཉི་ཤུ་རྩ་བཞིའི: of twenty-four (nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'twenty-four' + -'i 'of'): the twenty-four lands, sacred sites of the tantras
དཔའ་བོ: hero (dpa' bo; Sanskrit vīra): in the tantras the male companions of the sky-goer women
དཔའ་མོ: heroine (dpa' mo, the feminine of dpa' bo 'hero'): in the tantras a female companion of the sky-goers
གིང: ging, a class of wild dancing attendants in the retinue of the wrathful deities (ging; the word is left untranslated)
ཆོས་སྐྱོང་བའི: of those who protect the teaching (chos 'teaching' + skyong ba 'to protect' + -'i 'of')
རུས་པའི: of bone, made of bone (rus pa 'bone' + -'i 'of')
ཐོད་རྔ: skull drum (thod 'skull' + rnga 'drum'), a small double-headed drum
ཞིང་ལྤགས: perhaps a flayed skin, the skin of a slain enemy (zhing 'field', in tantric speech the body of an enemy, + lpags 'skin'); the sense is not sure
མི་གསུར: burnt offering of human flesh, taken so (mi 'human' + gsur 'burnt offering of flour and food, for its smoke'); the sense is partly guessed
བྱེ་བྲག: kind, sort, variety (bye brag): rol mo'i bye brag 'kinds of music' · distinction, difference: bye brag phyed 'make the distinction'
ཁམས: realm, world, element (khams): 'jig rten gyi khams 'the realms of the world'
ཁེངས་པ: filled, full (khengs pa, the intransitive 'to be full'; the transitive 'to fill' is 'gengs)
ཤིག་ཤིག: shaking (shig shig), a doubled word of motion; the sense is approximate
ཡོམ་ཡོམ: swaying (yom yom), a doubled word of motion; the sense is approximate
འགུལ་འགུལ་དུ: quiveringly, in a quivering manner ('gul 'gul 'quiver', doubled, + -du 'in the manner of')
འགས་པ: splitting, cracking ('gas pa 'to split, crack'): mgo 'gas pa tsam 'as much as splits the head'
འདིར་བ: perhaps booming, roaring, taken as ldir ba ('dir is the print's spelling; 'dir also means 'here'); the sense is a guess
སྣ་ཚོགས: various, of many kinds (sna tshogs): gar sna tshogs 'dances of many kinds'
བྱེད: to do, doing (byed, the present stem; past byas): gar sna tshogs byed 'doing dances of many kinds'
དམ་ཚིག་ཅན: one who has the commitment, keeper of vows (dam tshig 'commitment, vow' + can 'having'): one who holds the vows of tantric practice
བཅད་དུ: to cut, to impose (bcad, the past stem of gcod 'cut', + -du 'to'): chad pa bcad du 'ong 'come to impose punishment'
ལྷན་ཅིག་སྐྱེས་པའི: of the coemergent, born together (lhan cig 'together' + skyes pa 'born' + -'i 'of'; Sanskrit sahaja): the wisdom born together with the mind itself
མཚོན་སྐུད: taken as coloured thread, for tshon skud (tshon 'colour, dye' + skud 'thread'); mtshon itself is 'weapon, sign'; the sense is taken from the context
སྒྲིལ་མ: twisted, rolled up (sgril 'to roll, to wind' + -ma)
ཁྲ་ཤིག་ཤིག་པ: mottled and quivering (khra 'mottled, many-coloured' + shig shig 'quivering' + -pa); the sense is approximate
མེར་མེར་བ: flickering, as flames do (mer mer ba); the sense is approximate
ཕྱམ་ཕྱམ་པ: perhaps gleaming (phyam phyam pa); the sense is not sure
ཉམ་ང་བ: fearsome, dreadful (nyam nga ba): bkrag la nyam nga ba 'lustrous and fearsome'
རིགས་འཛིན: knowledge-holder (rigs 'dzin, this print's spelling of rig 'dzin)
གཙོ་བོ: chief, principal one (gtso bo): gtso bo lnga 'the five chiefs'
ཐད: straight at, right toward (thad): thad snying kar 'straight at the heart'
སྙིང་ཀར: at the heart, in the heart (snying ka 'heart' + -r 'at')
ལྔ་ལྡན: having five (lnga 'five' + ldan 'have'), short for lnga dang ldan pa: 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'light having five colours'
ལྡིར་བ: roaring, booming (ldir ba, from ldir 'to boom, roar'): ldir ba tsam 'as much as roaring'
སྒྲ་གྲགས: sound, noise, din (sgra 'sound' + grags 'to sound, be heard'): sgra grags la ldir che ba 'loud of sound and great in booming'
འུར་སྒྲ: din, roar ('ur sgra 'a sound of roaring')
བསོ་སྒྲ: perhaps a roar, another cry of the kind (bso sgra); the word bso is not known, and the sense is not sure
བཅས: together with (bcas, the short form of bcas pa): dang bcas nas 'together with … and then'
རང་དུ: as its own, as itself (rang 'self' + -du 'as'): rig pa'i rang du 'as awareness itself'
གླེན་ལྐུགས: dull and dumb, stupid and mute (glen 'stupid' + lkugs 'dumb')
བཀོལ་གཅོད: taken as being worked and slaughtered (bkol, past of 'khol 'to put to work', + gcod 'to cut'); the sense is partly guessed
འདས་པ: gone beyond, passed ('das, the past stem of 'da' 'to pass beyond', + -pa): mtha' las 'das pa 'gone beyond the limit, boundless'
མདུན: perhaps longing, taken as 'dun pa in mdun brtse gcig tu (mdun itself is 'front'); the sense is not sure
བརྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: perhaps one-pointedly, taken for rtse gcig tu (brtse itself is 'love' + gcig 'one' + tu); kept as printed, and the sense is not sure
ཁྱེད: you (khyed), the politer word, also used for more than one: khyed rnams 'you all'
མཁྱེན: to know, to take heed (mkhyen, the respectful word for 'know'): khyed rnams mkhyen 'you all know, take heed'
བསགས་པ: gathered (bsags pa, bsags the past stem of gsog 'gather'): tshogs ma bsags pa 'who has not gathered the accumulations'
དུས་གསུམ: the three times, past, present and future (dus 'time' + gsum 'three')
བདེ་གཤེགས: sugata, one gone to bliss, a buddha (bde gshegs, short for bde bar gshegs pa)
དེ་ཙམ: so many, so much (de 'that' + tsam 'as much'): de tsam cig gi 'of so many'
བཟུང: held, seized (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin 'hold': 'dzin / bzung / gzung / zung): bzung yang ma zin pa 'held, yet not caught'
འདྲ་བ: like, resembling ('dra ba): bdag 'dra ba 'one like me'
ཨ་ཙ་མ་ར: alas! a cry of dismay (a tsa ma ra, kept as printed; the usual cry is a tsa ma re)
མན་ཆད: from … downward, from then on (man chad): 'di man chad 'from this on'
བཏང་ཅིག: let go! (btang, the past stem of gtong 'let go', + cig, which marks a command; the imperative stem proper is thong); ma btang cig 'do not let go'
བཟུང་ཅིག: hold! (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin 'hold', + cig, which marks a command); the imperative stem proper is zung
ཞིང་དུ: to the realm, into the field (zhing 'realm, buddha-field' + -du 'to')
ཁོན: uncertain, kept as printed; perhaps a slip for kho na 'only, very' or khong nas 'from within'; khon itself is 'grudge, resentment', which gives no sense here; read, as a guess, 'right away'
དྲང་དུ: to lead (drang, the future stem of 'dren 'lead', + -du 'to'): drang du gsol 'I pray that you lead'
དགོངས་སུ: to heed, into the mind (dgongs, the respectful 'think', + -su 'into'): dgongs su gsol 'I pray, think of me'
ཆེན་པོས: by the great (chen po 'great' + -s 'by'): brtse ba chen pos 'by great love'
ལྷན་སྐྱེས: coemergent, born together (lhan skyes, short for lhan cig skyes pa)
དེ་རུ: to that, there (de 'that' + -ru 'to', a form of the particle la used, like -r, after a vowel)
སྐྱེ་བར: to be born, in being born (skye ba 'to be born' + -r): skye bar the tshom med 'there is no doubt of being born'
དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན: spiritual friend, teacher of virtue (dge ba 'virtue' + bshes gnyen 'friend'; Sanskrit kalyāṇamitra)
ཤ་སྟག་གོ: nothing but, all without exception (sha stag + the sentence-ending -go)
ངན: bad, evil (ngan): bag chags ngan 'bad habitual tendencies'
ཡན་ཆད: from … upward, and everything above (yan chad): de yan chad 'that and all above it'
འཕྲོད་པ: meeting, recognition ('phrod 'to meet' + -pa): ngo 'phrod pa 'the recognition'
ཐལ་ལོ: perhaps it is finished, a closing word (thal 'to pass through, to have gone by' + the sentence-ending -lo); the sense is not sure
ཨྠྀི: iti, 'thus', the Sanskrit word that closes a text, written as one stacked sign (i-thi)
རྒྱ: seal (rgya; Sanskrit mudrā): rgya rgya rgya 'seal, seal, seal', the threefold seal at the end of a treasure text
ཁྲོ་བོའི: of the wrathful ones, wrathful (khro bo 'wrathful one' + -'i 'of')
འཆར་ཚུལ: the way of dawning, how a thing dawns ('char 'dawn, arise' + tshul 'manner, way')
བསྟན་པར: to be shown, to show (bstan, the past and future stem of ston 'show', + -pa + -r 'to'): bstan par bya 'is to be shown'
དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པར: beyond measure, countlessly (dpag tu med pa 'immeasurable' + -r 'to')
གྲངས: number, count (grangs): grangs mang 'many in number'
